example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জীবনে যা করবি, তাই পরকালে ফল পাবি।
পরকালের কথা ভেবে বর্তমানকে উপেক্ষা করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: What you do in this life will bear fruit in the hereafter.
Don't neglect the present thinking about the future.
history: Refers to concepts from Hindu and Buddhist scriptures about life after death, common in Bengali folklore and literature.
note: Often used in contexts discussing karma and reincarnation in Bengali culture.
